rewrite.title: Clean up the branch's history
rewrite.hint: Squashes the fix-ups, rewords the messages to the project's convention and splits the commits that mix parts of the project. The result is a new local branch whose files are exactly the branch's: your branch, its remote and its tags stay as they are, nothing is pushed.
